build_AllScAIP_backbone: build an AllScAIP backbone model with graph attention blocks for molecular property prediction
create_AllScAIP_energy_head: create an AllScAIP energy head that predicts molecular energy from node representations using feedforward networks
create_AllScAIP_gradient_head: create an AllScAIP gradient energy force stress head that computes forces and stress via autograd
create_AllScAIP_direct_force_head: create an AllScAIP direct force head that predicts atomic forces directly from node representations
validate_AllScAIP_atoms_data: validate ASE atoms data charge and spin values against acceptable ranges for AllScAIP inference
